title: ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
subtitle: An entry-level security certification, taught from zero — no work experience assumed
audience: For self-paced learners preparing for the ISC2 CC exam on the 2026-09 outline, with no prior security job required. Five modules follow the five exam domains, each with a guided lab and a closing practice lesson, and every lesson exists in English and Thai with identical checkpoint answers. Labs are defensive only and run on your own computer, a free sandbox or a simulated surface.
outcomes: Apply the security principles the exam tests: the CIA triad, authentication and authorisation, risk management, security controls, the ISC2 code of ethics and governance basics (Domain 1, 24%)
Explain security governance: policies, procedures, standards and regulations, business continuity and disaster recovery concepts, and how an incident response plan fits with them (Domain 2, 17.3%)
Describe identity and access management: physical and logical access controls, least privilege and segregation of duties, and the identity lifecycle (Domain 3, 20%)
Recognise networking and cloud security concepts: IP, ports and protocols, common network threats, secure network design and cloud service models (Domain 4, 21.3%)

Carry out security operations and incident response: data handling and encryption basics, system hardening and configuration management, incident detection and response steps, and security awareness (Domain 5, 17.3%)
Review the whole outline in the capstone and plan your exam day (CAT format, 2 hours, 100–125 items, passing 700/1000)
